_about: Theme set of the extraction gold: six articles CHOSEN BY MATTER (H200 licensing, open-weight restrictions, hyperscaler capex), development only, never held out (gold-standard.md §4a). Written 2026-10-28 by Claude under the same ruler as gold-extraction.json, from the text, the theses the production request showed and the theme theses open at that turn; no model answer read. Frozen at the senior-analyst pass; hash in gold-extraction.sha256. Statements with empty bears_on are scored no_destination (an analyst notes them; no thesis existed yet).
